name: CareerPoint Marin County Career Center
description: Free career services and job training referrals for Marin County residents
fullDescription: CareerPoint Marin is Marin County's career center, part of the Workforce Alliance of the North Bay. It provides free job search and career development services to all job seekers regardless of income, education, employment status, or background.
whatTheyOffer:
- One-on-one career guidance and coaching
- Resume and cover letter help
- Job search assistance and interview preparation
- Referrals to training, education, and certification programs
- Career readiness workshops
- Hiring events and job fairs
- Computers, internet, printers, and scanners for job searching
howToGetIt:
1. Visit the Marin County Center at College of Marin Indian Valley Campus (Building 27, upstairs), Monday-Friday 8 am-5 pm
2. Or complete the online interest form and a Career Advisor will contact you
3. Work with a Career Advisor on your goals
4. Access training referrals and job search services
keywords: Marin County, workforce, CareerPoint, Marin Employment Connection, Workforce Alliance of the North Bay, AJCC, job training, career services, Novato
